# AL1309: Empty catch block swallows exceptions

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Reliability` |

| Analyzer | `Al1309EmptyCatchBlockAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Empty catch blocks silently swallow exceptions, making bugs invisible. At minimum, log the exception. If the exception is truly expected, add a comment explaining why it is safe to ignore.
